html:

As we celebrate this season of gratitude, the FYI Yacht family reflects on the many blessings of the year. It’s a time for us to express our heartfelt thanks for the incredible relationships we’ve built with our clients, the projects we’ve had the honor to work on, and the privilege of being part of such a vibrant and passionate industry. Your trust and support continue to inspire us, and we are deeply grateful for every opportunity to serve you.

Thanksgiving, at its core, is about gratitude—a concept rooted in the Holy Bible. In both the Old and New Testaments, giving thanks to God is a foundational expression of faith. The Bible reminds us in Psalm 100:4, “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.” These words speak to the power of gratitude, not only as a moment of reflection but as an invitation to acknowledge the blessings that surround us, both big and small.

As we pause to give thanks this Thanksgiving, we celebrate the relationships and successes that have defined our year. We are thankful for the trust you’ve placed in us, and for the opportunity to continue doing what we love. From our family to yours, we wish you a joyful and blessed Thanksgiving. May your hearts be full of gratitude, your homes filled with warmth, and your year ahead overflowing with blessings.

Happy Thanksgiving from the FYI Yacht family!
